name: Sentry
description: Monitor Sentry projects and alert rules for application error tracking and incident response compliance

config.setupInstructions:
Step 1 — Create a Sentry Auth Token
1. In Sentry, go to Settings > Auth Tokens (https://sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens/) — or for organizations: Settings > Developer Settings > User Auth Tokens
2. Click Create New Token
3. Add these scopes (read-only):
   - org:read       (list organizations)
   - project:read   (list projects)
   - alerts:read    (read alert rules + monitoring config)
   - member:read    (optional: read org members)
4. Copy the token (starts with "sntryu_" for user tokens, "sntrys_" for org internal-integration tokens)

Step 2 — Paste the token + your organization slug below

Sentry Region: This integration currently uses https://sentry.io (US). If you're on Sentry EU (de.sentry.io) or self-hosted Sentry, contact support — multi-region support is planned.
